scripts.dev:
wp-env start && printf '
────────────────────────────────────
 MySQL  127.0.0.1  root / password
 Admin  http://localhost:8888/wp-admin  admin / password
────────────────────────────────────
' && npm run grunt:watch
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:php && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:php:lint: wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'cd wp-content/plugins/waymark-wp && find . -name "*.php" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l'
scripts.test:php:setup: wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'composer global require --no-interaction --with-all-dependencies phpunit/phpunit:^9.6 yoast/phpunit-polyfills:^2.0'
scripts.screenshots: WAYMARK_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.js && node tests/e2e/screenshots.js publish
scripts.screenshots:check: WAYMARK_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.js && node tests/e2e/screenshots.js check
scripts.video: sh -c 'set -e; s="${1:-changing-basemaps}"; case "$s" in *.json) p="$s"; id=$(basename "$s" .json) ;; *) id="$s"; p="scripts/video/scenarios/$s.json" ;; esac; node scripts/video/tts.mjs "$id" && node scripts/video/record.mjs "$p" && node scripts/video/build.mjs "$id" && node scripts/video/validate.mjs' --
